# Quoventra

> Estimate smarter. Grow faster. AI-powered estimates, quotations and invoicing for modern businesses.

Website: https://www.quoventraa.com
Sitemap: https://www.quoventraa.com/sitemap.xml

## Product Overview
Quoventra is a B2B SaaS platform that helps service businesses, contractors, agencies, and freelancers convert plain-language job notes into accurate, itemized cost estimates using their own saved pricing rules—and then convert those estimates into client-approved online quotations and branded PDF invoices.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Estimate Generator**: Turns plain-language job descriptions into structured labour, material, and service line items using the business's saved catalog and pricing rules (never fabricates unapproved pricing).
- **Multi-Industry Pricing Engine**: Supports fixed, hourly, per-square-foot, distance-based, material-plus-markup, and custom pricing with decimal-safe calculations.
- **Online Quotations & Client Approval Links (`/q/[token]`)**: Shareable public quotation links where clients can review itemized quotes, approve, decline, or request changes online.
- **Branded Invoices & 9 Customizable PDF Templates**: 9 selectable executive template designs with custom brand color themes and direct PNG/JPG company logo uploads.
- **Customer CRM & Business Analytics**: Centralizes customer contact records, document histories, estimated vs. collected revenue charts, and quotation approval rates.

## Industries Served
- Construction & Renovation
- Cleaning & Janitorial Services
- Landscaping & Lawn Care
- Plumbing, Electrical & HVAC
- IT Services, Web Agencies & Consulting
- Freelancers & General Service Businesses

## Subscription Plans (USD / Monthly)
- **Free ($0/mo)**: 10 estimates/mo, 10 AI generations/mo, 25 customers, 1 team member.
- **Starter ($19/mo)**: 100 estimates/mo, 50 AI generations/mo, 250 customers, 2 team members, ad-free.
- **Professional ($49/mo)**: 500 estimates/mo, 250 AI generations/mo, 2,000 customers, 5 team members, custom logo & color branding.
- **Business ($99/mo)**: 5,000 estimates/mo, 1,000 AI generations/mo, 20,000 customers, 25 team members, custom branding + automated reminders.
